scope: Exact 33 blocker IDs, corrected source-site adjudication with delta-universe accounting.

corrections: Restored NOACC to accounting_reservation_rule and exact site owner to initial_owner for eight NECESSARY rows.
Corrected RESTART make.3/make.4 to the exact requests/documents map expressions, fields, owners, and transfers; retained REUSE only because the expressions pre-exist base.
Corrected complement-universe provenance to ADDED.tsv + CHANGED.tsv + REMOVED.tsv.
Adjudicated publication append NECESSARY for capacity-growing occurrences without claiming every append allocates.

go_rule: Propose C15_DELTA_GO only when all 33 exact blocker IDs are adjudicated, UNRESOLVED == 0, and the exact delta-universe complement has 319 IDs.

fp_complement_proof.universe_definition: candidate_id union from ADDED.tsv, CHANGED.tsv, and REMOVED.tsv only
fp_complement_proof.complement_canonicalization: UTF-8, lexicographically sorted IDs, one LF after every ID including final

rows.exact_expression_or_input: make([]byte, 8), populated big-endian from admitted key.ID
rows.allocation_and_nonempty_behavior: Unconditional once non-nil attempt.admit is called; length is always 8, so the language creates an eight-byte slice value (heap placement is not proved).
rows.accounting_reservation_rule: No privateB4ByteAccountV2 reservation/lease is called by this generic-layer site. finishAccepted explicitly emits the reservations ledger dimension as available known-zero (before=after=delta=0); under the accepted C15 semantics this is non-custodial generic observation storage, so no C15 byte reservation/release symbol applies.
rows.transfer_custody_chain: number local -> a.requestIdentity.requestKey.numberBytes -> finishAccepted identity -> owner observation (the patch does not make a second request-key-byte copy).
rows.natural_unreachability_release_retiremen: Becomes unreachable when the attempt/observation chain is discarded; if published, clearing owner.observation at terminal drops the final retained reference.
rows.refusal_terminal_applicability: Not reached for pre-effect refusals because they finish before pending.Begin/admit; accepted transactions only. Terminal handling applies later to the containing owner, not this local.
rows.concurrency_exact_once_applicability: The expression operates on an attempt/function-local value before publication; no owner mutex or exact-once release claim applies at this site. After publication, only the containing owner lifecycle is synchronized.
rows.copy_allocation_necessity_or_reuse: Necessary fixed-width materialization of numeric RequestKey identity; no existing []byte input/backing is available to reuse.

rows.exact_expression_or_input: append(detached, o); input o is each matching owner pointer from m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners
rows.allocation_and_nonempty_behavior: Conditional on a matching owner. The append count is at most the number iterated; detached was made with cap=len(m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners), so this append cannot grow its backing.
rows.accounting_reservation_rule: Capacity is reserved structurally by the paired make, not by a C15 byte account; no payload bytes are copied.
rows.initial_owner: The function-local detached slice created by the paired make.
rows.transfer_custody_chain: m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners element -> detached local -> return value -> runLifecycle local genericOwners -> requestTerminal/waitReleased for each owner.
rows.natural_unreachability_release_retiremen: The detached list becomes unreachable after the lifecycle loop; each pointed-to owner is retired through requestTerminal then waitReleased.
rows.refusal_terminal_applicability: Request refusal is inapplicable: this is stop/restart lifecycle partitioning. Terminalization is the purpose of the returned list.
rows.concurrency_exact_once_applicability: m.mu is held while partitioning; list construction itself needs no owner mutex. Each owner independently enforces terminal exact-once.
rows.copy_allocation_necessity_or_reuse: Reuses the paired make backing; exact capacity bound proves no append growth.

rows.exact_expression_or_input: append(retained, o); retained := m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners[:0]
rows.allocation_and_nonempty_behavior: Conditional on a nonmatching owner. In-place compaction appends no more elements than the original slice length, so capacity is sufficient and no new backing is allocated.
rows.accounting_reservation_rule: No C15 reservation: this is pointer-table compaction into already owned manager backing.
rows.initial_owner: Manager field m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners backing, viewed through local retained.
rows.transfer_custody_chain: manager table -> retained in-place compaction -> reassigned to m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners.
rows.natural_unreachability_release_retiremen: Backing remains manager-owned until later detach or Shutdown sets the table nil; dropped tail entries are explicitly nilled.
rows.refusal_terminal_applicability: Request refusal is inapplicable; retained owners remain live. Terminal behavior occurs only on a later lifecycle detach/shutdown.
rows.concurrency_exact_once_applicability: m.mu serializes compaction/publication; no per-owner terminal or exact-once action occurs here.
rows.copy_allocation_necessity_or_reuse: Reuses the existing manager-table backing by exact full-capacity reslice semantics.

rows.exact_expression_or_input: make([]*callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwner, 0, len(m.callHierarchyLayer1GenericOwners))
rows.allocation_and_nonempty_behavior: Unconditional per detach invocation. Capacity equals the current manager-owner count; when count is zero no element backing need be allocated, while nonzero reserves one bounded pointer worklist.
rows.accounting_reservation_rule: No privateB4ByteAccountV2 reservation/lease is called by this generic-layer site. finishAccepted explicitly emits the reservations ledger dimension as available known-zero (before=after=delta=0); under the accepted C15 semantics this is non-custodial generic observation storage, so no C15 byte reservation/release symbol applies.
rows.transfer_custody_chain: fresh worklist -> matching owner pointers appended -> returned to runLifecycle genericOwners -> terminalization loop.
rows.natural_unreachability_release_retiremen: Worklist naturally dies after the lifecycle loop; pointed-to owners release separately through requestTerminal/waitReleased.
rows.refusal_terminal_applicability: Request refusal is inapplicable. The worklist exists only to execute lifecycle terminal retirement outside m.mu.
rows.concurrency_exact_once_applicability: m.mu protects snapshot/partition; the list has one goroutine-local owner. No exact-once release applies to list backing.
rows.copy_allocation_necessity_or_reuse: Necessary independent worklist so terminal waits occur after unlocking without aliasing the manager table being compacted.
